profile.headline: Software Developer | Technology Consultant
profile.summary: I am a solution-focused software engineer that focuses on using code as a tool to bring people together. I have in-depth knowledge and applied skills in the MERN and React/Rails ecosystems, I also to continue to grow my skill set. I also have experience in mentoring and educating other developers. I am the current lead organizer for Atlanta's freeCodeCamp meetup, a non-profit that teaches people how to code for free. I am interested in joining a team that values willingness to do the work to up-skill as needed to become an asset as soon as possible while thinking about emphatic ways to make our team better stewards to the community at large.

positions.title: Software Development Consultant
positions.description:
Joined a 4-member team of developers as needed, developing features, effectively handling inquiries, triaging issues, and providing requisite resources using the MERN stack.
- Collaborated with the team lead to establish a robust testing framework, reducing the number of critical bugs by 30%, improving overall software quality, and accelerating feature delivery.
- Optimized the code review process by 20% through the implementation of GitHub Actions-powered streamlined CI/CD pipeline architecture on Azure on 5 - 7 sub-projects.

positions.title: Junior Software Developer ~ Vue
positions.locationName: North Atlanta, Georgia, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
- Conducted thorough user acceptance testing to verify that developed systems met the specific needs of business clients as outlined in functional requirements.
- Leveraged Asana and other custom tools to manage the product feedback process.
- Designed and implemented features in a React/React Native application, Mongodb database with a Node.js backend for the mortgage industry. 
- Collaborated in the creation of a CICD pipeline that automates the creation of pull request apps, runs automated tests and establishes a dedicated backup system using Github Actions and Azure Devops.

Technologies: React, Expo React Native, Azure Services, Node.js, MongoDB, Heroku, Cypress, Sentry, Github Actions, MongoDB
positions.insights: Skills: Cloud Infrastructure · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Assisted small business and solopreneur clients across various industries by completing needs assessments and offering web development strategy or strategic consulting.
- Customized templates and created custom post types using PHP, HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript.
- Adjusted the underlying code of an existing template to meet client needs.
- Presented wireframes for customer approval.
- Developed a step-by-step tutorial to ensure client proficiency in using the site.
- Managed site maintenance, including security and version control.
- Designed the user experience (UX) and user interface (UI).

positions.title: QA/ Junior Software Engineer || Digital Ads
positions.description:
- Utilized advanced knowledge of JavaScript, APIs (GAM), and in-house ad technologies to create prototypes of ads and mock pages, and to test code across multiple environments (web and mobile).
- Applied expertise in DOM manipulation to design specialized ad templates and prototypes.
- Decreased ticket backlog by 45% and provided developers with recommendations for scalable and efficient implementation strategies.
- Evaluated code from various sources to identify and fix broken code in ads, websites, and proprietary JavaScript codebases.
- Successfully managed web, iOS, and Android projects for Adult Swim, which won an Emmy Award in 2020.

positions.title: Mobile Developer Intern
positions.description:
*Internship Successfully Completed*
- Created and maintained visually appealing and interactive mobile applications.
- Developed and updated client apps using React Native, Node, Express, Javascript, Firebase, and Expo.
- Ensured a high-quality user experience and delivered quality code across multiple mobile platforms.

positions.title: Computer Repair Technician
positions.description:
- Provided efficient computer and mobile phone repairs that met the needs and expectations of customers.
- Demonstrated exceptional customer service, resulting in a 20% increase in the customer base.
- Demonstrated expertise in the use, repair, and maintenance of MacOs, Windows, and Linux operating systems.
- Demonstrated the ability to manage a varied workload and meet deadlines, effectively reducing work backlog.

positions.title: Contract Desktop Support Technician
positions.description:
- Travelled to customer locations via company vehicle to diagnose, repair, and/or replace computer hardware (such as PCs, terminals, printers, and data communication equipment) in accordance with customer service agreements.
- Installed hardware and peripheral components (such as monitors, keyboards, printers, and disk drives) on customer premises when needed, or assisted service personnel in installation.
- Responded professionally to customer inquiries in person and via telephone regarding system operation.
- Diagnosed system hardware, software, and operator problems and recommended or performed minor remedial actions based on knowledge of system operation.
- Demonstrated a commitment to meeting customer business needs.
- Coordinated activities and sought assistance from technical support as needed.

positions.title: Senior Solutions Specialist/ Technician
positions.description:
DESKTOP SUPPORT EXPERIENCE: 
- Ensured proper desktop functionality.
- Conducted computer repairs and replaced parts in both office and remote locations.
- Configured and installed new Microsoft and Macintosh systems.
- Troubleshot and resolved desktop support issues.
- Maintained up-to-date operating and maintenance procedures.
- Collaborated with other team members on assigned tasks.

positions.title: Secondary Science and Remedial Reading Teacher
positions.description:
eLearning School Coordinator
KEY ACCOMPLISHMENTS: 
- Assisted in the development and delivery of technology training for teachers.
- Worked with the school technology committee and senior staff to effectively use and integrate instructional technology.

DESKTOP SUPPORT EXPERIENCE
- Provided routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of computers.
- Installed, repaired, and replaced electronic components of computer equipment.
- Provided written support (work orders, inventory control, etc.).
- Performed diagnostic testing, maintained and stocked supplies and hardware.

volunteerExperiences.description: I organize the fortnightly meetup for FreeCodeCamp Atlanta (currently monthly) , where people who are learning to code come together to be amongst others learning to code. There's a definite benefit of knowing that you're not alone in this endeavor, and typically resources are shared, tidbits are learned, and bonds are formed. If you'd like to join us, we have meetings every other Sunday from 3-7 in the Atlanta Bread Company behind the Sandy Springs Marta Station. For more details, check us out on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/groups/free.code.camp.atlanta/
- Acted as a web development technical expert, providing 1-on-1 mentorship and technical support to students in an engineering immersion course (covering ReactJS, NodeJS, SQL, and PostgreSQL).

projects.title: Delta Mavericks - Kids Concierge
projects.description: An app which enhances the unaccompanied minor experience with better notification and communication. It uses low power bluetooth beacons and badges to show provide better location notifications as the unaccompanied minors (UA) travel from one point to another.

organizations.name: freeCodeCamp (Atlanta chapter)
organizations.description:
- Coordinate and host the freeCodeCamp meetup for the Atlanta chapter of 600+ active members.
- Provide training and advice to aspiring and junior developers on basic CSS, HTML,  JavaScript and related topics. 
- Support and resolve issues using both in-person and offline via mentoring sessions. 
- Assist in overcoming blockers and provide feedback on their personal side projects.
- Facilitate member networking  and develop accountability system for members.
